params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to a portion of his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Hecarim''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|12 to 24 for 7|1;3 to 18|formula=12%+2% every 3 levels starting from level 3 and capped at level 18}} of his {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.notes:
* ''Warpath's'' '''bonus''' attack damage will adjust itself to any temporary movement speed {{tip|buffs}} and {{tip|debuffs}} '''Hecarim''' is affected by.
** Since this only affects '''bonus''' values '''Hecarim''' will not dip below his regular attack damage if he is {{tip|slow|slowed}} below his '''base''' movement speed.
* The amount of movement speed scaling to '''bonus''' attack damage is refreshed every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

blurb.plain: Innate: Hecarim gains bonus attack damage equal to a portion of his bonus movement speed.

description.plain: Innate: Hecarim gains bonus attack damage equal to 12% – 24% (based on level) of his bonus movement speed.

blurb2.plain: Whenever Rampage hits at least one enemy, he gains a stack, up to a cap.

blurb4.plain: Rampage: For each stack, Rampage's damage is increased and the cooldown is reduced.

description.plain: Active: Hecarim cleaves his glaive around himself, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies, reduced to 60% against minions.

description2.plain: If this damages an enemy, Hecarim gains a stack of Rampage for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack increases Rampage's damage by 3% (+ 3% per 100 bonus AD) and reduces its base cooldown by 0.75 seconds, up to a 9% (+ 9% per 100 bonus AD) damage increase and a 2.25-second reduction of the base cooldown at maximum stacks. params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies for a short time.
params.blurb2: During this time, he gains '''bonus''' resistances and {{tip|heal|heals}} for a portion of any damage he and his allies deal to nearby enemies, with reduced healing on ally damage.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' surrounds himself with the Spirit of Dread for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every second to nearby enemies.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*4 to 60*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*4}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: While active, '''Hecarim''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and is {{tip|heal|healed}} for 25% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to enemies within the area from all sources, halved to {{ap|25/2}}% for damage dealt by allies. The healing is capped against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes: * The healing cap against minions accounts for every single one regardless of how many are present and/or affected by ''Spirit of Dread'' at the time of cast.

blurb.plain: Active: Hecarim continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies for a short time.

blurb2.plain: During this time, he gains bonus resistances and heals for a portion of any damage he and his allies deal to nearby enemies, with reduced healing on ally damage.

description.plain: Active: Hecarim surrounds himself with the Spirit of Dread for 4 seconds, dealing magic damage every second to nearby enemies.

description2.plain: While active, Hecarim gains bonus armor and bonus magic resistance and is healed for 25% of the post-mitigation damage dealt to enemies within the area from all sources, halved to 12.5% for damage dealt by allies. The healing is capped against minions and monsters.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and builds up {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} over a short time.
params.blurb2: During this time, '''Hecarim's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}}. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} the target, briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} them afterward.
params.blurb3: The effects are increased based on the distance he traveled in the duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|type=time active|key=%|25 to 65 for 13|0 to 3|formula=3.3% '''total bonus''' movement speed every 0.25 seconds. ''This is capped at 3 seconds.''}} '''bonus total''' movement speed|ms}}}} for 4 seconds.
params.description2: During this time, '''Hecarim's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced by a ''Devastating Charge'', empowering it to gain {{pp|type=distance traveled|50 to 250 for 9|0 to 1200}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}} in the target's direction, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second. If the target remains nearby during the dash, the {{tip|ghosting}} and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} ends prematurely and '''Hecarim''' {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} {{pp|type=distance traveled|150 to 350 for 9|0 to 1200}} units, though not through terrain, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and deals them {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 100 for 9|0 to 1200}}.
params.description3: ''Devastating Charge'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Hecarim|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description4: ''Devastating Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Hecarim's''' basic attack timer. '''Hecarim''' can cast any of his {{tip|champion ability|abilities}} during the dash. Devastating Charge's duration is paused during {{ai|Onslaught of Shadows|Hecarim}}.''
params.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 90*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Hecarim''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] while {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
** {{ai|Onslaught of Shadows|Hecarim}} will interrupt the dash.
* If the target does not remain nearby during the dash, ''Devastating Charge's'' effect will not be consumed.
* The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other sources of movement speed boosts.
* The bonus attack range stacks additively with {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.
* ''Devastating Charge'' will still apply its effects to the target even if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, but not if he goes into {{tip|resurrection}}.
* ''Devastating Charge's'' damage will apply {{sti|life steal|link=true}} and will affect structures.
* ''"Distance traveled"'' can be simple movement as well as {{tip|dash|dashing}} and {{tip|blink|blinking}}.
* ''Devastating Charge's'' damage will not bypass {{tip|block}} or {{tip|dodge}} but the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} will still be applied.
** ''Devastating Charge'' will still deal damage while {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Hecarim''' loses the {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} from ''Devastating Charge''.
** '''Hecarim''' will not use the empowered attack while {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* The {{tip|dash}} does not follow targets. The target's position at the time of the enhanced attack is the direction '''Hecarim''' will leap to.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will not resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Hecarim becomes ghosted and builds up bonus movement speed over a short time.

blurb2.plain: During this time, Hecarim's next basic attack will gain bonus range and cause him to dash. Upon arrival, he deals modified physical damage and knocks back the target, briefly stunning them afterward.

blurb3.plain: The effects are increased based on the distance he traveled in the duration.

description.plain: Active: Hecarim becomes ghosted and gains 25% – 65% (based on time active) bonus total movement speed for 4 seconds.

description2.plain: During this time, Hecarim's next basic attack is replaced by a Devastating Charge, empowering it to gain 50 – 250 (based on distance traveled) bonus range and cause him to dash in the target's direction, revealing them for 1 second. If the target remains nearby during the dash, the ghosting and bonus movement speed ends prematurely and Hecarim knocks them back 150 – 350 (based on distance traveled) units, though not through terrain, stuns them for 0.25 seconds, and deals them modified physical damage, increased by 0% – 100% (based on distance traveled).

description3.plain: Devastating Charge can critically strike for (100% + Infinity Edge 40%) AD bonus physical damage.

description4.plain: Devastating Charge resets Hecarim's basic attack timer. Hecarim can cast any of his abilities during the dash. Devastating Charge's duration is paused during Onslaught of Shadows.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} summons spectral riders and {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies they pass through.
params.blurb2: Upon arrival, he {{tip|fear|fears}} and gradually {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies for a duration based on the distance traveled.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location and summons 5 spectral riders {{tt|in an arrow formation|see notes}} that charge alongside him in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies in their path and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.description2: Upon arrival, he {{tip|fear|fears}} nearby enemies for {{pp|type=distance traveled|0.75 to 1.5 for 11|0 to 1000}} seconds and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pp|type=distance from '''Hecarim'''|0;0 to 99|0;150 to 300 by 25|formula=Minimum of 0% slow at ≤150 centered range from '''Hecarim''', maximum of 99% at 300 centered range from '''Hecarim''' (linearly interpolated).|key=%}}.
params.description3: ''The wave of spectral riders travels independently of '''Hecarim''' and will always charge at the same distance.''
params.speed: {{tt|1100|Both dash and spectral riders missile speed}}
params.width: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|80|Individual spectral riders missile width}}|{{tt|480|Width of full effect given by outermost riders}}}}
params.notes:
* The spectral rider missiles originate at '''Hecarim's''' location, 145 units behind and 100 units to either side of him, and 290 units behind and 200 units to either side. They travel 1510 units forward parallel to Hecarim from their origin each.
* Only the spectral riders deal damage to enemies they pierce, '''Hecarim''' only dashes and fears enemies at the end of it.
* The slow improperly counts as an additive percent movement speed modifier rather than a multiplicative one.{{bug}}
** The strength is unaffected by {{tip|slow resist}} as a result of this behavior.
** This means it can unintentionally stack with the effects of other slows.

blurb.plain: Active: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies they pass through.

blurb2.plain: Upon arrival, he fears and gradually slows enemies for a duration based on the distance traveled.

description.plain: Active: Hecarim dashes with displacement immunity to the target location and summons 5 spectral riders in an arrow formation that charge alongside him in the target direction, dealing magic damage to all enemies in their path and revealing them for 2.5 seconds.

description2.plain: Upon arrival, he fears nearby enemies for 0.75 – 1.5 (based on distance traveled) seconds and slows them by 0% – 99% (based on distance from Hecarim).

description3.plain: The wave of spectral riders travels independently of Hecarim and will always charge at the same distance.

speed.note: Both dash and spectral riders missile speed

variants.label: Width of full effect given by outermost riders
